szoveg_eredeti: As the use of artificial intelligence tools has proliferated, Joe Mazzulla has found ways to incorporate them into his workflow and challenge his thinking. “Every offseason, really this offseason, it’s like, okay, let’s test all of our processes,” Mazzulla explained at Celtics shootaround on Friday morning. “Is our pregame film process the right way? Is our halftime film process the right way? Is our film room set up for learning the right way? How should our film room look?”
